references.text: Bethel is first mentioned here when Jacob named the place Bethel after his dream, which means 'house of God'.
God commanded Jacob to go to Bethel and live there, and to build an altar to God who had revealed himself to him.
Joseph's sons are mentioned in connection with the land distribution, showing the territory of the house of Joseph.
Bethel is mentioned as a border city in Benjamin's inheritance, which was formerly called Luz.
Jacob adopted Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh, who together make up the house of Joseph.
The Lord was with Judah when they conquered the hill country, just as the Lord was with the house of Joseph.
God's promise to be with Joshua is now fulfilled for the house of Joseph in their conquest.
